rationale: Both run the same depth-first flood fill from a player's starting edge with the same six neighbour offsets, and both are clear. A is slightly more readable and self-documenting. It has a class docstring stating which player connects which edges, a named NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS constant with a comment on each direction, and a descriptive helper name. It parses rows with split(), which tolerates any whitespace. B inlines an anonymous offset tuple, has no documentation, and strips spaces with replace(). B does call strip() on the input, which guards against surrounding blank lines, and its goal-set membership test is tidy. A assigns lambdas to names, which PEP 8 discourages. These are minor; overall A communicates intent better.
